method: Independent read-only source audit, with root verification of named static locations; no arena outcome collection

findings.finding: Collector works on one arena, but report rows do not expose arena identity. Run IDs recur across independently frozen arenas.
findings.required_before_comparison: Bind each untouched report to its exact arena/freeze and use an explicit external portfolio tuple (arena,run_id,project,arm,trial,task_id); never silently pool recaptures.

findings.finding: Freeze-bound exclusions apply to every task in a listed run ID; they do not propagate to other run IDs automatically.
findings.required_before_comparison: List only existing affected fork/integration IDs explicitly; retain stale/dangling/overlap checks and raw rows.

findings.finding: Integration run kind is distinct, while task-card loading is selected by Parallel rather than ParallelIntegration. Task08 integration may receive ordinary08 expectations.
findings.required_before_comparison: Adjudicate exact integration-card semantics before interpreting expected sets/escalation. Do not use an ordinary08 card as evidence of fork integration truth.

findings.finding: Sequential grouping uses project/arm/trial while fresh run IDs can introduce additional rows. Missing task cards can default into implementation-eligible counts.
findings.required_before_comparison: Validate one run identity per project/arm/trial, exact known task cards, and one designated task boundary; initial/final and derived assessments are repeated observations, not new tasks.

findings.finding: Optional sidecars yield small sets; absence/malformed/native-format mismatch can all become unavailable and do not provide complete snapshot/provenance binding.
findings.required_before_comparison: State the exact retained sidecar/receipt identity and limitations. Absent data is unavailable, never unused/empty; reconstructed outputs cannot prove actor consumption.

positive_boundary: A public-helper pass is kept separate from frozen hidden-evaluator correctness; terminal actor, final helper, conflict/deadline and evaluator state participate in counted outcome.
status: Final measurement-contract gaps to settle; no final metrics or source repair performed
classification: measurement tooling, not a Markitect Core/Module defect
limits: Static audit does not establish actual incidence in collected runs
No correction to frozen task/oracle/product semantics
Final matching must preserve raw statuses and comparison exclusions; no favorable rescore
